topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I can’t wrap my head around it. We built castles and caught fireflies, whispered secrets under the stars. How can it all just... vanish? I keep replaying our latest conversations, searching for clues. Was there something I missed, a sign I overlooked? I ebxplain our history, our bond, but it’s like I’m talking to a stranger now. They nod, polite, but there’s a wall, a fog. I’m grasping at shadows, trying to spark recognition. It’s like yelling into the void, expecting an echo. I need to make them see, to feel, to remember. This can't be the end of us.
